issues.description: Solution for Aufgabe 05 returns the Landkreis name as the column avg_flaeche instead of computing the average area. The problem statement asks for the average area per Landkreis (a numeric value) plus the Landkreis name and Regierungsbezirk. The solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql selects 'kreis as avg_flaeche' which yields a text value (kreis) in the avg_flaeche column rather than AVG(flaeche). This is a structural mismatch between the problem specification and the provided solution and would mislead students about the intended aggregation and column types.
issues.suggested_fix:
Replace the incorrect selection of 'kreis as avg_flaeche' with an aggregation of the numeric area column. For example:

SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) AS avg_flaeche
FROM Gemeinde
GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis
ORDER BY kreis;

This returns the requested numeric average area per Landkreis along with the Landkreis name and Regierungsbezirk, matching the problem statement.
